Allegedly, the child was placed on stage by her parents so while the baby was clapping, so were the cheeks on stage! 😳 There are a lot of questions here, but why are y’all mad at Snoop? Why was the child at a 4/20 event??? Tap into the latest w/ @lorenlorosa.
